title: SLO degradation detection & recovery playbook: initiative tracker and triage flow
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a production-ready initiative artifact and Linear tracker that operationalizes SLI degradation detection, automated error-budget gating, and a clear recovery playbook for oncall and PM/Eng stakeholders. This ticket covers: 1) definition of degradation thresholds by workload class, 2) embedding automated gating rules into the initiative tracker, 3) a step-by-step recovery playbook (triage, mitigation, rollback, postmortem), 4) dashboard templates and alerting knobs, and 5) handoff/playbook for Dedicated and Private customers on stricter SLAs.
acceptance_criteria: Degradation thresholds documented for latency and availability across three workload classes (interactive, batch, background)
Automated gating rule implemented in tracker that marks initiative as throttled when error-budget burn > 20% in 1h and SLI violation rate > threshold
Recovery playbook steps published in Confluence and linked from Linear ticket
Dashboard template (Grafana) created with SLI trend, burn rate, and suggested mitigations
Oncall runbook includes clear escalation and rollback criteria and a postmortem template
out_of_scope: Model-level quality regressions and prompt-level A/B experiments are handled in separate eval initiatives; this ticket focuses on platform SLOs (latency/availability/throttles).
notes_and_decisions: 2026-02-12: Decided to use three workload classes to balance signal-to-noise; soft thresholds for canary rollouts and hard thresholds for customer-facing Dedicated plans.
2026-02-18: Agreed to surface both rolling 1h burn and 24h trend to avoid oscillation-prone automation.
2026-02-25: Chose to implement gating in the initiative tracker rather than the alerting pipeline to centralize decision state and audit trail.
2026-03-04: Opted to include a mitigations library in Confluence with runbook play buttons (linking to ops-runbook scripts) for common degradation patterns.
